material: Buddy Talks AUDIO FILE - words we say wrong
lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll work on words that give away a learner even at an advanced level. They’re... …TRICKY WORDS! Fluent speakers still get these wrong: colonel

These words rarely appear in class, so nobody ever hears them corrected. The higher your level, the more one mispronounced word stands out.
